page_title: VER 0-0 BOL | Verona v Bologna 18/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' Excellent touch by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
90+3' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Suat Serdar (Verona). Federico La Penna doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Federico La Penna blows his whistle. Isak Hien (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.

86' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Riccardo Calafiori, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
85' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

83' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Nikola Moro (Bologna) coming on for Remo Freuler.
80' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) replacing Victor Kristiansen.
79' Flag goes up against Milan Djuric (Verona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Dan Ndoye will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
75' An attempted cross from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared.
73' Stefan Posch (Bologna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Federico La Penna didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
72' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ondrej Duda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
70' Marco Baroni is forced to make a change. Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is unable to continue due to injury, Suat Serdar comes on.
69' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' The percentage of ball possession is – 43:57.
65' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
63' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
62' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Davide Faraoni will be replaced by Filippo Terracciano (Verona).
62' Substitution. Federico Bonazzoli makes his way off the pitch and Milan Djuric (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
61' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bologna get a corner.
60' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Jesper Karlsson is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
60' That will be all from Lorenzo De Silvestri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Stefan Posch (Bologna).
59' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is out of play. Verona will have a throw-in.
54' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
53' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) takes a short corner kick.

52' A sweet pass finds Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
50' The foul by Davide Faraoni (Verona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico La Penna.
50' Darko Lazovic (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
47' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
46' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Marco Baroni is stunned as referee Federico La Penna shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
45+3' Davide Faraoni (Verona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+2' Ondrej Duda (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico La Penna interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
42' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jesper Karlsson (Bologna), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
42' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

41' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Lorenzo Montipo is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Bologna win a corner.
40' Davide Faraoni (Verona) fires the corner kick right at goal and only a defender’s headed clearance prevents a goal.
39' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Verona.

38' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
37' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Victor Kristiansen (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
36' Josh Doig is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
36' Sam Beukema (Bologna) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
32' Josh Doig (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' Martin Hongla (Verona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
30' The Verona players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Federico La Penna signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
29' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Federico La Penna wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
29' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Isak Hien (Verona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
28' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul after Michael Folorunsho (Verona) hacks down one of his opponents.

23' Victor Kristiansen floats in a cross for Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
22' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
21' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
18' Federico La Penna shows the yellow card to Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) for a heavy challenge.
15' Davide Faraoni (Verona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.
14' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players. Verona will take a corner kick.
11' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

9' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Cyril Ngonge (Verona) is caught offside!

5' What a chance that is! Martin Hongla (Verona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Victor Kristiansen (Bologna).
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Federico La Penna.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
